physical_justification: The original staircase realization of the inclined roof perturbs the room's lowest semidiscrete eigenmodes realization-dependently (its 15 modes <=100 Hz fail all adjacent pairs, evidence r130d_original_q0_bandlimited_modal_convergence_evidence_2026-10-11). A non-convergent discretization cannot serve as the spatial authority; the exact-geometry hybrid eigensystem replaces it.

The signed 40/80 Hz observable is a band quantity. Modal terms far above the band (>200 Hz = 2.5x the highest bin) enter the recorded scalar only through finite-record leakage of the 250 ms rectangular window and its end-of-record derivative terms (55-292% of adjacent-pair differences, preregistered endpoint attribution). They are artifacts of the record operator, not stationary room physics; a modal band-limit is the standard remedy and preserves the stationary modal content of the observable.

Source waveform (q0 8-sample impulse), source/receiver 8-node weights, dt, h, Nt and the 250 ms record are all preserved verbatim; only the spatial discretization (staircase -> exact-geometry) and the evaluation projection (full-spectrum -> <=200 Hz modal) change.
preregistration: Commit and push this plan before the requalification execution. The runner verifies plan bytes, input SHA-256s, local ancestry and remote HEAD. The 200 Hz cutoff and the three original gates are frozen here; the full cutoff sweep including failing entries is reported transparently and may not be cherry-picked.

requalified_contract.source_receiver: exact original SHA-pinned vox_out.h5/comms_out.h5 native 8x8 indices and weights
requalified_contract.q0: exact original 8 sample native impulse in_sigs[:,0]; all later samples 0
requalified_contract.discretization: exact-geometry hybrid eigensystem per SHA-pinned grid (conforming roof P1 + hybrid flux), NOT the staircase graph
requalified_contract.observable: signed 40/80 Hz transfer reconstructed from semidiscrete modes with eigenfrequency <= 200 Hz

scoring: Reconstruct the <=200 Hz cumulative modal transfer per grid from the committed band decomposition (conservation <=1e-10 relative first), apply the unchanged three gates to all four adjacent pairs plus strict monotonicity of all three metric sequences, and publish the complete cutoff sweep {100,200,400,800,1600,3200} alongside.
honesty: This requalification does not amend or rescale the canonical original outcome: original staircase contract remains SELF_CONVERGENCE_FAILED, product remains NO_GO for the original observable. The requalified contract is a new, separately justified acceptance definition and is reported as such in every document.
